lessons.claim: The normal stress differences of a hard-sphere Brownian suspension (small Pe) are N1/(mu gdot) = +0.899 phi^2 Pe and N2/(mu gdot) = -0.788 phi^2 Pe (Brady-Vicic 1995). The signs (N1>0, N2<0) are the same as for a polymer, but the magnitude ratio |N2/N1| = 0.877 is entirely unlike a polymer's 1/7=0.143 -- the magnitude ratio becomes an indicator that distinguishes the systems. ★ N1 comes entirely from the direct Brownian component (testable by switching it on and off)
